environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a public-facing listener on port 443. The ALB forwards all traffic to the target group on port 8080. No additional authentication layer exists between the internet and the application. The service is accessible at https://auth-api.example.com/. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.auth_layer: none - application handles its own JWT verification
